title: Emma
author: Jane Austen
summary: Emma Woodhouse is clever, rich and sure she knows best. She sets about matchmaking among her neighbours in the village of Highbury, with consequences she did not expect.
readIf: you enjoy comic social observation and a heroine who is flawed but easy to forgive.
skipIf: you want a swift romance, since the love story builds quietly.

pairings.reason: Austen's most famous, with a more sparkling romance and sharper pace.
A modern, comic romance that borrows from Austen's habit of showing a heroine's mistakes.
A bubbly, modern take on Regency matchmaking and society gossip.
